column1: # Deskripsi SKILL — putaran keempat puluh dua ekor panjang.
# Bagian 1 dari sepuluh berkas (75-84). Tetap 1:1, harfiah ("=").
# --- serangan ---

=Select 1 enemy target within <color=#f26c1c>6 tiles</color> of the user to launch an attack, dealing AoE <color=#42cce0>Freeze damage</color> equal to <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> of attack to it and all enemy targets within <color=#f26c1c>3 tiles</color> that ignores Cover damage reduction.
